== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Colonies are diverse settlements found throughout the galaxy, varying significantly based on their political affiliation. [[Galactic Union]] colonies often consist of metallic rings in space or floating [[Iron|iron]] hives, such as the recycling-focused [[Ironville]]. In contrast, [[Free Worlds]] colonies exhibit more individuality; some appear as mountains filled with machinery and tunnels, while others are modular, rectangular outposts resembling cramped laboratories. Some colonies are massive megacities or even planets with extensive connections. A unique and highly specialized entity known as the [[Zenith Colony]] exists, which is associated with [[Shadow Ark]]. This colony functions as a sanctuary for its residents and possesses the ability to expand from a small size to something larger than a moon. It contains an internal space capable of housing entire star systems under a violet sky and is characterized by its ability to remain hidden. Other colonies may be subject to orbital defenses, invasions by the [[Legion]], or structural instability that threatens the lives of those within.}}
